text: I will incline my ear and consent to a proverb; On the lyre I will unfold my riddle.
So that he should live on eternally, That he should never see the pit (grave) and undergo decay.
But man, with all his [self] honor and pomp, will not endure; He is like the beasts that perish.
But God will redeem my life from the power of Sheol, For He will receive me. Selah.
A man [who is held] in honor, Yet who lacks [spiritual] understanding and a teachable heart, is like the beasts that perish.
